text:
sam: Heads-up — we're seeing a slow drift to >45% idle GPUs during low traffic windows in us-west1, costs spiking. Thinking about tuning the Cluster Autoscaler flags and expander strategy. Anyone free to weigh in? :eyes:

maya: Yep, saw the graphs earlier. Two quick levers: try `--expander=compact` and lower `--scale-down-unneeded-time`. Compact packs pods into fewer nodes which helps GPU packing.

raj: Compact can help but beware oscillation if `--scale-down-unneeded-time` is too low. We had churn when we used 5m. Tune to ~15m and add `--scale-down-delay-after-add=20m`. Also set `--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.35`.

lucas: Another option is `--expander=least-waste` with better nodepool weights. If you combine least-waste and node pool weights you can bias scale-up to cheaper preemptible pools and keep stable on stable pools.

maya: For GPUs I'd also recommend `--max-empty-bulk-delete=3` (we were nuking 8 nodes at once and causing binpack regressions). And `--balance-similar-node-groups=true` helps even distribution so we don't leave small stragglers.

sam: Good catch on bulk delete. The cost spike was partly from frequent reclaim and then warm-up of model caches. What about mixing preemptible + guaranteed? Any proven weight settings?

raj: We run nodepool weights like: guaranteed=100, preemptible=60 during business hours, preemptible=30 overnight. Also use `--expander=priority` in one cluster to bias guaranteed for tail latency. Works well.

elaine: Can we canary this in a single AZ/region first? I can patch the CA deployment in staging to the proposed flags. Example helm patch we used:```helm upgrade cluster-autoscaler stable/cluster-autoscaler --set extraArgs.expander=compact --set extraArgs.scale-down-unneeded-time=15m --set extraArgs.max-empty-bulk-delete=3```

lucas: Add telemetry: enable longer sampling for `nodegroup-size` and `scale-events` in our observability so we can correlate cache warming vs scaling. Without that you can't prove improvement.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Notice: patch job queued for cluster-autoscaler in staging (job id: ca-canary-2026-07-18).

maya: Also think about `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false`? For GPU workloads we want CA to consider pods with ephemeral local fs when packing. But double-check stateful pods.

sam: Thanks — plan: elaine canary patch in staging tomorrow, we'll run with compact + scale-down-unneeded-time=15m + max-empty-bulk-delete=3 + balance-similar-node-groups=true, collect 48h telemetry, then decide roll to us-west1. Raj/lucas/maya — ping if you'd like to join the post-canary retro. :thumbsup:
